capability.description: US Core 9.0.0 server: US Core CareTeam Profile

test.name: Refuses CareTeam without subject
test.description: US Core CareTeam Profile requires CareTeam.subject (at least 1); base FHIR leaves it optional. Without it the resource is refused.

test.name: Refuses CareTeam without participant
test.description: US Core CareTeam Profile requires CareTeam.participant (at least 1); base FHIR leaves it optional. Without it the resource is refused.

test.name: Refuses CareTeam without participant.role
test.description: US Core CareTeam Profile requires CareTeam.participant.role (at least 1); base FHIR leaves it optional. Without it the resource is refused.

test.name: Refuses CareTeam with more than 1 participant.role
test.description: US Core CareTeam Profile allows at most 1 CareTeam.participant.role; base FHIR allows any number. 2 of them are refused.

test.name: Refuses CareTeam without participant.member
test.description: US Core CareTeam Profile requires CareTeam.participant.member (at least 1); base FHIR leaves it optional. Without it the resource is refused.

operation.description: Delete CareTeam resources created in test.
